display_name: 源域流起点学习与留出对照
description: 两条小规模固定预算流训练轨迹在独立源记录上比较起点与路径速度误差。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: Local RTX 5070 Ti GPU0, deterministic FP32 TF32off

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: 384 fit and 128 heldout physical source IDs, three views per record
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: First 384 and next 128 IDs in existing legal ordered 32768-ID source context; all three views kept together
data.validation_ref: 128 physical IDs disjoint from this diagnostic training; DURA source training may include related data

permissions.claim_scope: Source waveform NMSE and path velocity error only, never identity accuracy or target model selection

checkpoint.initialization: New zero-head flow per arm; fixed source DURA cached outputs; real DURA checkpoint no-query source smoke
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed DURA source-only checkpoint and deterministic source context; no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source IQ and DURA context only, no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Both fixed five-epoch arms, no candidate weights saved, no target data

execution.host: Local Windows GPU; N607 CPU real-checkpoint no-query smoke
execution.gpu_policy: Local GPU0 short source diagnostic, preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on invalid checkpoint, nonfinite computation, or unavailable GPU

expected_artifacts: result.json: held-out path velocity error, output and anchor source NMSE for both fixed arms

dimensions: five epochs x two fixed arms
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; no target or TX truth

rows.method: Uniform versus half-origin conditional IQ flow
rows.purpose: Diagnose source path and deployment-origin behavior without using the target
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026110612, order 2026110613, mask 2026110711, fixed source prior 2026110707
rows.scenario: 64 fixed source training IDs, three source simulation views
rows.budget_ref: 384 source IDs x three views x five epochs, per arm; 128 disjoint heldout source IDs x three views
expected_artifacts: result.json: held-out path velocity error, output and anchor source NMSE for both fixed arms

notes: Arms match initialization, optimizer, source records and seed; fixed different time distributions.
No trained weights saved and no effect on already-registered formal candidates; source proxy is not identity performance.
Fixed first 512 source IDs may be nonrepresentative; disjoint holdout only applies to this small diagnostic training.
